messages:
mara: Dropping a fresh Figma for the batch embeddings preview + rerank export flow. Looking for quick UX + a11y calls. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/ax/preview_batch_v2.png
jin: Nice layout. Two quick asks: make the export CTA explicit (not just an icon) and indicate file size estimate before exporting large sets
sam: For column ordering I vote: selection checkbox, id, source_preview, original_score, reranked_score, rank, metadata. Keeps scores adjacent for comparison
ella: Accessibility: live region for export progress. Use aria-live='polite' and announce percent + when completed. Also ensure keyboard focus moves to the resulting download link
aria: Contrast: the "reranked" pill uses a light orange, fails 3:1. Recommend swapping to a richer orange (#d65a00) or add 600 weight to text
mara: Good catch. Also UX: when users upload a batch, we show sample vectors preview. If any vector dims mismatch, show a per-row callout and an inline "recompute" button, not modal
jin: CSV expectations: include a header row with column types. Example header: id,source,orig_score,reranked_score,rank,vector_length,metadata
sam: If exporting >10k rows, stream export server-side and surface a toast: "Preparing your export — we'll email a link when ready". Avoid browser OOMs
ella: Keyboard flow nit: currently actions are after ID. For screenreader users, put checkbox first so selection is discoverable immediately
aria: Copy tweak: change "Export" -> "Download ranked vectors (CSV)" to reduce ambiguity for non-technical users
mara: Rerank transparency: add a small info icon next to reranked_score that opens a tooltip: "reranked by: model-name v2, method: learned-ranker, seed: 42"
jin: Also add a toggle to show/hide raw vector (heavily truncated) to help debugging without exposing huge columns by default
sam: Performance: preview table should lazy-load embeddings (render placeholders) for long lists. Use virtualization and aria-rowcount for SRs
ella: a11y tests: verify with NVDA and VoiceOver, tab order, aria-sort on headers, and ensure announcements on export complete. Also verify contrast on pagination controls
aria: Small export filename pattern idea: {project}_{dataset}_ranked_{YYYYMMDD}.csv. Put that example in the tooltip next to filename input
mara: I'll update the mock and annotate Figma with these points. Can folks do a quick pass by EOD? We want to freeze copy + basic a11y for dev handoff tomorrow
design-bot: preview: https://img.redwood.ai/ax/preview_batch_v2.png
jin: I'll review after standup; focusing on filename tooltip and live region wording
sam: I'll run a perf checklist on large exports tomorrow
ella: I'll do NVDA passes and post findings
aria: Quick checklist in-thread: filename tooltip, aria-live, checkbox-first, contrast, rerank tooltip, streaming export UX, sample-size estimate
mara: Thanks all — will push updated frames and ping back
design-bot: thread-state: unresolved
